public_definitions: The goal is to review the respiratory infection surveillance dashboard and select the operational route that best fits the overall case pattern for this record.
The dashboard is the evidence source for selecting the appropriate respiratory infection surveillance follow-up route.
The options are: 'Route the record to increasing-activity follow-up', 'Route the record to easing-activity follow-up', 'Route the record to standard surveillance monitoring'.
